import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import subprocess,re
r=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout','sources/striker-williams-1108.1172.pdf','derived/stwi.txt'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=60); print(r.returncode,r.stderr)
t=open('derived/stwi.txt',encoding='utf-8',errors='replace').read()
pages=t.split('\f'); print('pages',len(pages),'chars',len(t))
kw=['a + b + 1','a+b+1','n + m + 1','m + n + 1','[2] ×','× [2]','noncrossing','Fon-Der-Flaass','Fon-der-Flaass','order of']
for i,p in enumerate(pages):
    hits=[k for k in kw if k in p]
    if hits: print(i+1,hits)
print(' '.join(t.split('\f')[0].split())[:1500])
dps=open('derived/dps.txt',encoding='utf-8',errors='replace').read().split('\f')
print('=== DPS PAGE 12')
print('\n'.join(re.sub(r' {2,}',' ',l).strip() for l in dps[11].splitlines() if l.strip()))
